caption: The 248B-token MarinFold model supplies exactly floor(L/2) predicted contacts to Helico, using archived 100-rollout consensus rankings. L is the frozen input sequence length. Filter mapped separation <6 before selecting contacts; every predicted map reaches its budget. Three diffusion samples/map, highest ranking_score selection; no MSA or oracle seed contacts. *Oracle supplies two random subsets of floor(L/2) ground-truth contacts, selects one of three samples per subset, then averages subset accuracies. All other pairs stay unknown in both contact arms. Same 305 natural proteins (95 validation + 210 test), with 95% protein-bootstrap intervals. Oracle caps at 109 versus 110 requested contacts for one protein, and uses two maps rather than one. See MARINFOLD_L2.md, ORACLE_L2.md and coverage.csv. AlphaFold2/3 and Boltz-2 use the same archived MSA queries and alignments underlying these depth bins, with templates disabled and protein-chain-only inputs. Confidence selects among five AF2 pTM models (three recycles), 25 AF3 samples (five seeds, ten recycles), or 25 Boltz-2 samples (one seed, ten recycles). These are controlled shared-MSA runs, not the models’ full default search pipelines.
